summary: Iteration 2 regression pass on Susan Tumuhairwe brand site after visual/theme/imagery updates. Backend inquiries API pytest suite 5/5 passing. All 4 routes load with no console errors and no broken images. Nourish family-section renders 3 loaded images (pregnant woman, mother & baby, children). Home crossroad cards present. Speaking page confirmed LIGHT theme (body bg rgb(251,248,242) off-white) with blue accents (not dark navy). Inquiry form: empty submit shows error toast 'Please complete the required fields.', valid submit shows success toast and clears the form; new inquiry (TEST_QA Playwright) persisted and returned as newest via GET /api/inquiries. Mobile 390x844: hamburger nav-menu-open opens mobile-menu with 4 nav-links; no horizontal overflow on any of the 4 pages (scrollWidth=390).

issues: Preferred date still uses native <input type=date> instead of shadcn Calendar+Popover (carry-over from iteration_1; low priority).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py GET /api/inquiries is unauthenticated and returns every stored inquiry incl. email — acceptable for MVP but must be admin-gated before production.
InquiryCreate has no max_length constraints on name/organization/message — consider bounding to prevent oversized payloads.
created_at stored as ISO string in Inquiry but StatusCheck stores datetime — minor inconsistency.
seed_data_creation: One inquiry created via UI: name=TEST_QA Playwright, email=qa_playwright@example.com, event_type=Keynote. Also one from pytest run (TEST_Jane Doe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All recently changed items verified: African/Ugandan imagery loads (no broken images), Nourish family-section shows 3 images, Speaking page is light theme with blue accents, hero/crossroads present, inquiry form persists to Mongo. Mobile hamburger + mobile-menu + nav-links wired. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_inquiries.py remains the regression baseline.
